opportunities.description: For a given project name, find its top Hacker News story and GitHub repo stats, then save a 'Lead' note.
steps: Search project name on Hacker News (Algolia)
Note top story title, points, age
Search project name in GitHub search
Open top repo, read stars and last release
Add a new note 'Lead: <name>. HN ... GitHub ...'
